name: Shreevatsaa Finance and Leasing Limited
about: Shreevatsaa Finance and Leasing Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company operates through the Trading Activity and Financing activity segments. It engages in the business of loans and advances; investment; trading in stocks; and mutual fund units. The company was formerly known as Swastik Commerce and Finance Private Limited and changed its name to Shreevatsaa Finance and Leasing Limited in 1995. Shreevatsaa Finance and Leasing Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.
